name: Okta Access Airlock
description: Governed Okta administration. Reads, plans, applies, and proves custody of every change against the Okta System Log.

credential_spec.name: Okta (OAuth service app, private key JWT)

commands.title: Verify connection
commands.description: Probe every granted OAuth scope and name each missing one alongside the commands it blocks.

commands.title: Rate limit headroom
commands.description: Report the remaining Okta rate limit headroom per endpoint bucket, so a bulk plan is never started that cannot finish.

commands.title: Find users
commands.description: Find users by Okta filter expression. Results from filter may feed a write. Results from search are marked advisory and may not, because Okta serves search from an eventually consistent datasource.

filter.label: Filter expression
filter.help: Okta filter, for example: status eq "ACTIVE". Defaults to active users.

search.label: Free text search
search.help: Eventually consistent. Marks the result advisory so it cannot feed an apply.

max_records.help: Stop after this many records and report the set as incomplete.

commands.title: Get one user
commands.description: Profile, status and credential posture for a single user.

user_id.label: User id or login
user_id.help: Okta user id, or the user's login.

commands.title: List a user's access
commands.description: Groups, reachable applications and standing admin roles in one read. Application links are what the person can actually open, rather than what an assignment table implies.

user_id.label: User id or login
user_id.help: Okta user id, or the user's login.

commands.title: List live credentials
commands.description: OAuth grants, per client refresh tokens and enrolled devices, which are the things that survive a deactivation. Reports plainly that Okta exposes no way to enumerate active sessions.

user_id.label: User id or login
user_id.help: Okta user id, or the user's login.

commands.title: Find groups
commands.description: Find groups by filter, paged to completion, reporting whether the set is complete.

q.label: Name prefix
q.help: Match groups whose name starts with this.

max_records.help: Stop after this many records and report the set as incomplete.

commands.title: Get group members
commands.description: Every member of one group, paged to completion so a set is never half reported.

max_records.help: Stop after this many records and report the set as incomplete.

commands.title: Check rule entanglement
commands.description: Report whether removing a membership would also permanently modify a group rule. Okta adds a manually removed user to the rule's exception list, which affects every other member the rule governs and cannot be undone without suspending the rule org wide.

user_id.label: User id
user_id.help: The user whose membership would be removed.

group_id.label: Group id
group_id.help: The group they would be removed from.

commands.title: Explain access
commands.description: Why can this user reach this application? Direct assignment, or through which group, or through which rule. The question an access review exists to answer.

commands.title: Blast radius of a deactivation
commands.description: What this user loses on deactivation, and more importantly what survives it: group memberships, OAuth grants and refresh tokens all persist, and active sessions cannot be enumerated at all. Also names any group left with no owner.

commands.title: Plan a membership change
commands.description: Compute a group membership change without applying it, snapshot and fingerprint the state it depends on, and name every removal that would also permanently modify a group rule. Refuses to plan against a membership it could not read to completion.

add.label: Users to add
add.help: User ids to add. Already present users are reported as no ops.

remove.label: Users to remove
remove.help: User ids to remove. Non members are reported as no ops.

commands.title: Plan a deactivation
commands.description: Compute a deactivation with its full blast radius, snapshot and fingerprint the state it depends on, and recommend suspension instead where the change may need undoing. Nothing is written.

user_id.label: User id
user_id.help: The user to plan a deactivation for.
